verdict.rationale: Cekura supports conditional/rule-based evaluators that respond to specific conversation conditions, automated cron jobs for testing workflows, live drift detection, and GitHub Actions CI/CD triggers, which together enable rule-based automation on events within its voice-agent testing domain. However, this is scoped to evaluation/testing triggers rather than a general-purpose 'if event then action' automation engine across arbitrary events. missing for 10: a general user-facing rule builder/UI for defining arbitrary trigger-action automations, evidence of broader event types (e.g., non-call business events) triggering actions, and independent hands-on verification of the conditional-actions feature working as described.
